falsification_rule: If the two repairs together materially improve fewer than 15 correctly routed non-language cases on the next frozen rerun, treat the concept-knowledge/arithmetic diagnosis as insufficient and reclassify before further repair.
guardrails: No benchmark-specific runtime branches or templates.
No product-specific semantics may answer a generic question without a resolved product.
GSI may select only caller-governed concept component IDs and owns no insurance truth.
Arithmetic may use only validated customer-supplied values and must not imply final insurer liability.
The exact same frozen 36-turn dev set must be rerun before any additional repair.
